column1: # The integration corpus: real repositories kibble runs against on a schedule,
# each pinned to a commit and to the verdict counts a person verified by hand.
# A drifting count means kibble's judgment changed, not the repository, which
# is exactly the regression this exists to catch. Columns are tab-separated:
# Brew checks reach formulae.brew.sh, so a network blip can turn one PASS into
# a SKIP and move a count for a week. A red corpus run whose only drift is one
# fewer pass deserves a rerun before it deserves a bug hunt.
